text:
mira: quick update — finished the reranker+embed throughput sweep across g5.4xlarge, g4dn.xlarge, and c7g.large in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. ran dims 384/768/1024, batch 8/32/128, seq=128. attaching TL;DR numbers inline.

mira: TL;DR (embed vectors/sec, rerank tokens/sec) — us-east g5: 384@32 -> 14.2k / 9.1k, 768@32 -> 9.8k / 6.2k, 1024@8 -> 3.1k / 2.0k. eu-west g5 ~5-7% slower p50, p95 gap +12% (network/placement variance). c7g CPU (avx2) handles 384 small-batch well: 384@8 -> 2.4k embed / 1.2k rerank but p95 tail is noisy.

mira: command used: `bench-run --model rerank-v2 --embed-dim {384,768,1024} --batch {8,32,128} --seq 128 --region $REG --instance $TYPE --warmup 300 --duration 600`

jasper: nice. did you separate coldstart vs steady? numbers look warm.

mira: yes — reported are steady-state after 300s warmup. coldstart p95 can be 2-3x for GPU when kv-cache cold and batching ramping. saw a specific spike at ~t+45s on g5 where p95 jumped ~1.8x — traced to PCIe rsvd throughput on that host.

bench-bot: automated summary attached: `runsuccess 2039999999: 24 configs, 1440s total, 3 failed warms (host IO), avg p50/p95 logged to /s3/bench/2039999999/summary.csv`

li: any kernel differences? which attention kernel did you use for g5?

mira: default runtime chose `fused_mha_v1` for 384/768, but for 1024 it switched to `block_mha` (memory-friendly). swapping to `fused_mha_v2` (experimental) improved p95 on 768 by ~9% but increased memory, so capacity per-GPU down by ~6%.

sandeep: did you try int8 quant for reranker? quality/regression numbers?

mira: yes quick pass — int8-static on 768 gave throughput +1.9x on g5 for rerank tokens/sec, p95 improved. quality: ran evalset A (10k pairs) — MRR drop 0.7%, top1 exact 0.8% down. flagged for deeper eval but looks within acceptable envelope for low-cost tier.

olivia: curious about capacity planning: if customer needs p95 <= 200ms for embed dims=1024 with batch=8 in us-east, how many qps/GPU can we promise?

mira: approximate: on g5.4x we saw p95 ~180ms at ~260 qps (embed queries/sec for 1024@8). safe RA: 200 qps to keep buffer. for eu-west plan ~185 qps (apply 10% slack).

jasper: what about proxying overhead when cross-region fallback kicks in? earlier runs had +30ms median when proxying to us-west fallback. did this run capture that?

mira: yes we ran cross-region tests: local->local vs local->fallback. proxy overhead ~22-35ms median (depends on inter-region RTT), p95 extra 40-75ms. that pushes some configs over 200ms p95 — we should prefer model variants with lower seq or smaller dims for fallback path.

li: can we add a micro-benchmark in CI that fails if p95 degrades >5% vs baseline?

sandeep: +1. add a daily canary focused on 768 int8 and 1024 fp16 with synthetic tails. keep dataset small (5k) to be cheap.

mira: noted. I'll: 1) push `fused_mha_v2` test to perf branch, 2) add int8 nightly eval (compare MRR/top1), 3) add p95 guard rails in canary.

olivia: thanks — can you paste the summary CSV lines here? makes it easier for sizing doc.

mira: pasted subset:
```
config,region,instance,embed_dim,batch,embed_qps,rerank_tps,p50_ms,p95_ms,kernel,notes
g5,us-east,g5.4x,1024,8,260,200,95,180,block_mha,steady
g5,eu-west,g5.4x,1024,8,235,185,105,205,block_mha,steady
g5,us-east,g5.4x,768,32,980,620,45,85,fused_mha_v2,improved p95
c7g,us-east,c7g.large,384,8,2400,1200,120,420,opencl,high tail
g4dn,us-east,g4dn.xlarge,384,32,14200,9100,18,55,fused_mha_v1,good median
```

mira: reactions: :rocket: on g4 median, :warning: for c7g tail for production SLAs.

jasper: good input — I'll update capacity calculator with 200 qps/GPU for 1024@8 us-east and add a fallback rule that downgrades model to 768 dims when cross-region used.

sandeep: also add note: quant boosts throughput but run int8 MRR nightly. don't auto-roll quant unless eval passes.

mira: yep. I'll open follow-up PR with results + `bench-bot` artifact links. will tag ops for PCIe host that flaked.

bench-bot: ticket created: #infra-203999A (host-io-flake) assigned to ops-team.

olivia: perfect. thanks everyone.
